text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Marvelous Sunday is walking through the 
dorm lobby...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Marvelous-san! We're about to have hot 
pot together, would you like to join us?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: A pot?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We were all talking about feng shui, and 
we decided eating hot pot would boost our 
luck!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yellow for financial luck! Green for 
health! Let's all bring ingredients for 
the luck we wanna boost and toss 'em into 
a mystery hot pot! Sound good?♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mystery hot pot! Sounds so fun~! Count me 
in, count me in~☆

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Alright then, I'll turn on the lights!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, the broth is so colorful☆ Simmering, 
bubbling, boiling over★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The smell is sweet and sour too, it feels 
so weird☆ Ahahahaha~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's quite eccentric...! By the way, 
what ingredients did you put in?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm going with pineapple to boost my 
financial luck! Plus, we have fruit hot 
pot, so I figured why not?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'll have conger eel! Long fish are 
supposed to improve your interpersonal 
luck. What about you, Spe?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I picked spinach! I wanted to boost my 
health luck. Wait, that's quite a 
combination... I can't even imagine what 
it'll taste like...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~... That's true. Well then, who 
wants to eat first?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hi, hii! Me first☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food! *nom nom nom*...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mmm, marvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous... wait, what does it taste 
like!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen! It's crackling in my 
mouth! And the texture is squishy, then 
crunchy!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And then my tongue started tingling, and 
at the end it felt so cool! I was so 
surprised~! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I can't tell if it's delicious or 
disgusting!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'll just have to see for 
myself...! Besides, I'm getting hungry!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Me too! Let's all eat together!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Ready, and―― Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: —Kh!? This flavor is...!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! MARVELOUUUS☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was it the effect of the mystery hot pot? 
Marvelous Sunday's running only grew 
sharper after that.
